title: Delhi Police asks Mamata Banerjee to join probe as witness in 2013 protest clash

ai.summary: Delhi Police summoned Mamata Banerjee to testify in a 2013 case involving a protest clash in Delhi where she and Trinamool Congress leaders confronted police over the route to enter the Planning Commission headquarters.

facts.claim: Delhi Police has served a notice to former West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, asking her to join the probe and record her statement in a 2013 case related to a confrontation between Trinamool Congress leaders and police personnel during a protest in New Delhi.
facts.quote: Delhi Police has served a notice to former West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, asking her to join the probe and record her statement in a 2013 case related to a confrontation between Trinamool Congress leaders and police personnel during a protest in New Delhi.

facts.claim: The case dates back to April 2013, when Banerjee, accompanied by Trinamool Congress ministers and MPs, visited Delhi to protest against the alleged assault on then West Bengal Finance Minister Amit Mitra by activists of the Students' Federation of India (SFI), the student wing of CPI(M).
facts.quote: The case dates back to April 2013, when Banerjee, accompanied by Trinamool Congress ministers and MPs, visited Delhi to protest against the alleged assault on then West Bengal Finance Minister Amit Mitra by activists of the Students' Federation of India (SFI), the student wing of CPI(M).

facts.claim: Delhi Police had advised Banerjee to use a designated VIP entrance instead of the main gate, where Left activists had gathered. However, she got out of her vehicle and walked towards the main entrance.
facts.quote: Delhi Police had advised Banerjee to use a designated VIP entrance instead of the main gate, where Left activists had gathered. However, she got out of her vehicle and walked towards the main entrance.

facts.claim: According to a police report submitted to the Union Home Ministry, CISF personnel opened the main gate to allow Banerjee to enter. Mitra, who was following her, was surrounded by protesters before reaching the entrance. He was manhandled, and his shirt was torn. Security personnel later escorted him inside.
